proposal_question: Should cross-wiki filters exist at all?

_proposal_pass.proposal_question: Should cross-wiki filters exist at all?

key_arguments_for: Helps with dealing with cross-wiki abuse (spam in particular) and makes local admins' jobs easier.
Local admins should have the rights to view global filters.
Formalizing the process for global abuse filter editor, including a week of discussion before granting the right.
key_arguments_against: Concerned about the use of these filters for outright censorship.
